newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady on Friday with several dealers citing an improvement in nearby demand.
"We had inquiries this morning," a Texas dealer said. "The interest is for nearbys and we have run out of feed for that. Feed mixers are buying."
St Louis prices firmed slightly but eastern markets such as Ohio were waning, another dealer said.
A Kansas broker said he expected demand to increase in a week or so as farmers finish planting.

"Buying interest has waned, but in a another week or so I would expect a pickup in demand," the broker said. Farmers would have planted most of their corn and would be seeking supplemental feed, the broker said.
